# Sparkling Mutuals v3.6.2

## Fixes and improvements

- **Party discovery cache repairs:** existing successful profile/discovery reads now update current party members' cached discoveries. `/sparkling`, `/sparkling party`, `!missing` and scheduled personal stats can repair stale requirements without changing modes or making extra requests. Older responses cannot erase discoveries or locally confirmed catches.
- Results from requests started before an account/realm reset, provider change or member removal/rejoin cannot update the replacement cache entry. Unrelated players cannot modify active party requirements.
- **Full Clear capture reconciliation:** confirmed captures remain matched to visible population until its count falls, including head/capsule UUID changes lasting beyond the 2.5-second guard. Lingering captured models cannot create extra requirements for Mantis Shrimp, Troodon or other critters. Positive remaining models still block completion; once the transition resolves, a genuinely new sighting can raise the target. Unloading a newly established remainder does not count as catching it.
- **Named self boss PBs:** asking for your own Wumpa/Doomspiral Solo or Duo PB by IGN returns your personal record, matching the unnamed command. Other clients continue to use their observed records for that player; biome queries keep their existing behavior.
- **Better `/sm debug` output:** shows per-member cached missing discoveries using available names, plus per-species captures, population targets, remaining-model evidence, scan confirmation and pending capture count (`captureDebt`). Debug name formatting makes no extra name requests.

## Installation

Install **one** JAR matching your Minecraft version and remove the previous Sparkling Mutuals JAR:

| Minecraft | Release file | Fabric API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 26.1.2 | `sparkling-mutuals-3.6.2+mc26.1.2.jar` | `0.155.3+26.1.2` |
| 26.2 | `sparkling-mutuals-3.6.2+mc26.2.jar` | `0.161.0+26.2` |
| 26.3 | `sparkling-mutuals-3.6.2+mc26.3.jar` | `0.163.0+26.3` |

Requires **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, matching **Fabric API**, and **Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20**. HM API and MoulConfig are bundled. Existing settings, saved Warp Lists, history and PBs remain in place.

## Validation

Clean buildAllTargets passed for Minecraft **26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3**: **1,086 tests per target**, **21 build-helper tests** and three verified JARs. Regression coverage includes captured models lingering beyond 2.5 seconds, head/capsule UUID replacements, resolved capture transitions and genuinely new remainders. Existing discovery-cache and named PB regression coverage remains included. All **63 local links** in the changed documentation passed.

No additional live Minecraft/Hypixel or visual testing was performed during release preparation. Live server entity timing and API response ordering retain their documented validation limits.

[Changes since v3.6.1](https://github.com/johnceoskyblock/sparkling-mutuals/compare/v3.6.1...v3.6.2)


Latest fixes merged in [PR #89](https://github.com/johnceoskyblock/sparkling-mutuals/pull/89), with all 12 GitHub integration checks passing.

# Sparkling Mutuals v3.6.1

## Bird and Gazer checking fixes

- Bird Sparkling checks can recover missed spawn messages through a fresh qualified Forest scan: shared captures plus currently rendered birds must cover all known feeding opportunities, including known starting extras, with no floor or held food remaining. Macaw pairs count as one feeding. Historical UUID totals and out-of-radius scans do not supply this fallback.
- New held food, another consumption batch or newly remaining floor food clears the old population proof; otherwise verified proof survives unloading. `/sm debug` now includes pending spawn confirmations and the fallback target.
- Gazer checking uses the greater of retained UUID evidence and confirmed shared catches plus current uncaptured Gazers, capped at four. This includes fast catches made before UUID observation. Progress survives unloading/reentry; Full Clear still requires actual captures.

## Honeyhive and chat fixes

- Nearby, unambiguously matched Honeyhive holograms now correct saved readiness: **Click to loot!** clears stale cooldowns, and **Refill in** updates the saved deadline even when an older loot timestamp or Queen Bee flag exists. Corrections persist across relogs and supply the fallback while out of range.
- A **two-second grace period** after confirmed loot/Queen Bee messages lets stale holograms catch up. Countdown rounding jitter is coalesced to avoid repeated configuration writes. Block honey levels do not determine readiness.
- Removed routine local downtime request/readiness/ticket/timeout/departure/reset notices and the contest-warning chat line. Entry-block explanations and Shift bypass, contest title/sound warnings, automatic party contest requests, combined party reminders and ticket-earned announcements retain their existing behavior.
- Renamed the receiver setting to **Respect !dt requests** and shortened related settings descriptions.

## Doomspiral throw timer

- Added a movable, resizable **Doomspiral capsule throw tick timer**, enabled by default under Safari helpers → Capture tools.
- The Haunted stirring message starts a countdown using observed server ticks. Defaults are **98 emergence ticks** and a **4-tick throw lead**, producing a **94-tick countdown**. Both settings are adjustable and saved.
- The HUD appears within **10 blocks of a living, loaded warden**, continues counting while out of range, and shows **THROW NOW** at zero for up to 40 server ticks. A confirmed Doomspiral catch clears it.
- The cue resets on Safari/run/world/connection changes. It is a timing aid, not an automatic throw or capture guarantee; distance, server lag and connection timing affect results.

## Sparkle Warping and Warp List

- **`/warping`** toggles Sparkle Warping; **`/warpingdelay <seconds>`** sets its delay. The default/reset delay is **23 seconds**. Saved custom delays are preserved. The local alert reads **Warping Now**.
- Added optional **Auto-party**, toggled with **`/autoparty`** or settings, and an editable **Warp List** for 26 supported critters. Auto-party and warping both default off.
- Known Sparkling detections queue the matching saved IGNs during an active warp countdown. Invitations are paced **one every two seconds**, skip known party members, and deduplicate repeated names/detections. Existing parties require leadership; confirmed solo players can create a party.
- Invitations stop at the warp deadline, a sent/confirmed warp, cancellation or a run/world/connection change. Unknown particle detections do not invite. These features use the existing party lookup without adding profile or ShinyHunter requests.
- **Import CSV** replaces the saved Warp List from row 1's critter headers and rows 2–11's names. It supports quoted cells and UTF-8 BOMs, ignores unsupported columns/invalid names, and preserves the list if cancelled or invalid. Missing/empty critter columns clear their entries.

# Sparkling Mutuals v3.6.0

Consolidated features and fixes from the 3.5.x series and v3.6.0, reflecting their final behavior.

## Settings, HUDs and visuals

- **Clear water** removes Safari water fog and the underwater overlay, with a **0–100% opacity slider**, default **60%**, and optional Sodium support.
- Independent **Hide critter ESP** and **Hide floor-drop ESP** options for each mode, default off. Tracking continues while visuals are hidden. Either hide option disables that mode's optional profitable-critter ESP in Unique/Sparkle.
- Organized settings groups, charcoal-and-gold styling, configurable party-member/drop colors, and independent label sizes for quest drops, rewards and party members.
- Independent **Show outside current biome** controls for each floor-drop type.
- Fresh installs use **Basic tickets**, borderless HUDs, current-biome reward-drop ESP and contest warnings at three and one minutes. Automatic ticket selection and capture projections default on. Existing saved choices remain respected.
- Adaptive HUD layouts use a **640×360 reference canvas**. **Reset positions** restores the bundled layout without resetting feature settings.
- A local welcome offers clickable shortcuts once per Hypixel/Alpha connection. **`/sm help`** opens the mode-aware command list.

## Commands and estimates

- **`/profit [ticket]`** and **`/profits [ticket]`** rank the top ten by estimated **shard plus Safari Essence revenue per run**. All 37 species are eligible. Ticket options are `basic`, `economy`, `premium` and `first-class`; no argument uses the saved selection, initially Basic.
- Profit estimates use cached prices, spawn averages, ticket-specific essence multipliers and the saved price preference. Results show shard-only totals until essence prices load. Fees and ticket costs are excluded.
- Profitable-critter ESP uses the same ticket-aware ranking. Rockmite remains in command results but receives no extra profitable highlight; normal mode requirements remain separate.
- **`/rates`** estimates checks per run and average runs per Sparkling for the selected mode. Full Clear uses Full Party averages; Unique/Sparkle use cached party needs. Command and ESP reads start no extra price/profile requests.
- **`!missing [IGN]`**, **`!ticket [IGN]`** and **`!tickets [IGN]`** default to the verified sender. Ticket replies include totals across tiers. Timesave discovery replies list Bluebird, Parakeet and Macaw individually.
- **`!since`** and **`!since unique`** show the run count first and allow matching results from different clients. Non-detection party replies use Shiny/Shinies wording.

## Party coordination

- **`!m [biome]`** replies use the responder's observed biome at the run's **30-second checkpoint**, retained after travel. Bare `!m` selects that assignment; `c/f/i/h` request a specific biome. Missed checkpoints produce no reply, and run/world/mode changes discard stale replies.
- Unique replies group **Uniques left to capture**. Sparkling source notes list known remaining mounds, Snoozle walls, unopened Gemzie chamber, bird food, nests, Gazers and coins. Full Clear lists positive capture deficits. Unknown counts and generic loading/check-spawns notes are omitted; **None** means no known tasks to list.
- **Auto biome reports**, default on, independently controls automatic `fd/cd/id/hd`. Unique/Sparkle suppress `id` after Wumpa is caught. Sparkle reports Icy only when nobody needs Wumpa and another Icy discovery needs checking; Full Clear retains ordinary reporting.
- **Announce starting quest items**, default off, controls starting-item reports and unused-item party reminders. Reports wait **0.5 seconds after Hunting Hotspot**, can amend newly found starting supplies, and recheck resources/discovery needs before sending. Reminders use one paced batch per run. Hotspot announcers are separately opt-in per mode.

## Changes since v3.5.5

v3.5.6 restores persistent cooldown and distant ESP visuals while keeping capture/completion evidence strict.

### Fixes

- **Litterbug:** retain the last observed hidden position and its eight-second cooldown timer when the model or name tag unloads. Resurfacing replaces the marker. A confirmed associated capture retires the marker and model UUID; an unmatched catch clears uncertain missing positions without inventing a capture.
- **Shyworm:** an unrelated unmatched capture no longer removes a loaded underground worm's visual marker. Surface-height tracking can use a confirmed label, real movement, or a previously bound distant label. Confirmed associated catches still retire the correct UUID family, and uncertain absent locations are cleared conservatively.
- **Distant models:** known visual bindings can survive name-tag unloading at distance. Flitter and Driftling still require an appropriate label/movement or known distant-binding fallback; nearby missing-label evidence remains conservative for other applicable models.
- **Capture cleanup:** follow an already-bound label into its `CAPTURING` state to associate a later confirmed catch. Multiple simultaneous candidates remain ambiguous and are not guessed. A restored ordinary label clears its capture-transition candidate.

These are visual-persistence fixes. Retained markers and distant label fallbacks do not become personal/shared captures, capsule-contact proof, or remaining-population/completion evidence. Existing mode, profitable-ESP, group and biome visibility settings still apply. New runs reset the retained visual state.

### Installation

Install **one** JAR matching your Minecraft version and remove the older Sparkling Mutuals JAR:

| Minecraft | Release file | Matching Fabric API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 26.1.2 | `sparkling-mutuals-3.5.6+mc26.1.2.jar` | `0.155.3+26.1.2` |
| 26.2 | `sparkling-mutuals-3.5.6+mc26.2.jar` | `0.161.0+26.2` |
| 26.3 | `sparkling-mutuals-3.5.6+mc26.3.jar` | `0.163.0+26.3` |

Requires **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, matching **Fabric API**, and **Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20**. HM API and MoulConfig are bundled. The 26.1 build supports **26.1.2 specifically**. Existing settings and saved history remain in place.

### Validation

After a clean build start and the Shyworm test update, final buildAllTargets verification passed for Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2, and 26.3: **1,131 tests per target**, **21 build-helper tests**, and three verified 3.5.6 distribution JARs. All **40 relative links** in the changed documentation passed, alongside UTF-8 and diff-whitespace checks. GitHub PR checks verify integration; the tag-release workflow rebuilds and verifies publication.

No additional live Minecraft/Hypixel or visual testing was performed during release preparation. Name-tag unloading, server entity/capsule timing and projection appearance retain their live-validation limits.

[Full changelog: v3.5.5 → v3.5.6](https://github.com/johnceoskyblock/sparkling-mutuals/compare/v3.5.5...v3.5.6)

Merged in [PR #83](https://github.com/johnceoskyblock/sparkling-mutuals/pull/83), with all 14 GitHub integration checks passing.

## Changes since v3.5.4

v3.5.5 adds Safari Clear water, ticket-aware profit estimates, expanded history/reward tools, and fixes to rendering, capture evidence, ticket selection and party reminders.

### Water, ESP and settings

- Added **Clear water** under Safari helpers → Visual cleanup, enabled by default only inside Safari. It removes water fog/underwater overlay and adds a saved **0–100% Water opacity** slider, default **60%**. Existing opacity choices are preserved. Lava, water physics and ordinary distance fog remain unchanged. Vanilla hooks cover all three supported targets; optional Sodium handling is included. Shaders/other renderers still need live verification, and the separate ClearWaterLava mod should be removed when testing this integrated feature.
- Improved current-model/label checks and the post-capture settling window for Flitter and Shyworm, alongside Driftling/Chuckwalla. Added Shyworm projection/visibility fixes and stable Scrappy food labels once all three identities are observed. These helpers do not manufacture personal catches.
- Added saved party-member ESP color and consolidated floor-drop color controls in ESP. Settings descriptions and the welcome are shorter. **Announce starting quest items** is an independent Party Interactions toggle, now default **off**; existing explicit choices remain saved. Added separate opt-in hotspot announcers per mode.

### Commands and estimates

- Replaced `/profitablecritters` with **`/profit [ticket]`** and **`/profits [ticket]`**. Ticket arguments autocomplete as `basic`, `economy`, `premium`, and `first-class`; no argument uses the saved selection, initially Basic.
- The top ten now rank estimated **shard plus Safari Essence revenue per run**, with compact colored rows and hover breakdowns. All 37 species are eligible. Essence uses rarity yields and ticket multipliers of **1.00 / 1.10 / 1.25 / 1.50**, separately from the existing **1.5025 shards per critter** assumption. Estimates exclude fees and ticket costs. Until essence prices load, results explicitly show shard-only totals.
- Profitable ESP shares the ticket-aware ranking. Rockmite stays in command results but gets no extra profitable highlight; Snoozle is eligible again. Normal mode-required highlights remain separate. The existing Bazaar response now retains Safari Essence prices; command/ESP reads start no new requests.
- `/rates` now uses the selected mode: Full Clear uses Full Party averages without needing discovery data; Unique and Sparkle use cached party needs and their own planned-check rules. These remain estimates, not current entity counts or guaranteed rates.
- `!missing`, `!ticket`, and `!tickets` now accept an omitted IGN and query the verified sender. Explicit-name queries and existing cooldown/cache behavior remain.

### History, rewards and PBs

- Added recorded hotspot and actual summary shard, **Safari Essence**, and **Hunting XP** totals, including a bounded window for delayed live summaries. Essence is valued once using cached prices without reapplying ticket bonuses. Imports with incomplete reward data retain marked estimates; complete rewards can be valued directly.
- Runs supports exact run-number jump navigation (`123` or `#123`) while retaining surrounding rows and sort order. Sparklings adds critter-name filtering alongside Mine only. History tabs have draggable scrollbars. Average duration uses known positive runs below ten minutes; known essence and reward details are shown.
- Hover a Sparkling row for **[Log]**, opening a read-only in-game viewer centered on its original system announcement, with line numbers, scrolling, sideways browsing and Jump to catch. Source locations are validated against the account, catcher, species and time; compressed logs are read in memory.
